description: With 10GB of free storage (see https://cloud.box.com/promos for details on current promotions), Box makes it easy to store, manage and work with all your files and documents wherever you are - on the web, from your desktop and on your phone and tablet. Box helps you get work done on the go. It's fast, secure and simple to use, so you can be productive from anywhere. More than 25 million users and 225,000 companies use Box - including 97% of the Fortune 500.
